title: IBC Tank 4-Way Splitter Adapter – Adjustable for Irrigation
descriptionHtml:
Only one outlet on the water tank?

With a single outlet on the IBC tank you have to reconnect the hose every time you water different spots. It gets fiddly, leaks and takes time in the middle of watering.

Four hoses – from one tank

The splitter adapter divides the tank's outlet into four separate connections, each with its own adjustable valve. Connect drip irrigation, a hose, a tap and the animals' water at the same time – fits 1/2"–3/4" hose and S60 connection.

Features

  • 4 separate outlets – each with its own shut-off.
  • Adjustable flow – control each hose separately.
  • Fits 1/2"–3/4" hose & S60.
  • For garden and farm irrigation.

Change of mind
